document.about: Transcript of Chair Powell's press conference, January 2024: a running header on all 27 pages, the only place the transcript says it is the final one, over a footer that only numbers the page.

notes: Running headers and footers were once dropped from the text altogether and kept only in doc:runningText. A header is now kept once, before the first page's text, and a footer once, after the last page's. These checks fail if it is dropped again, and if it comes back on every page.

checks.issue: The header repeated on every page was removed from all of them, so the text never said FINAL.

element.text: January 31, 2024 Chair Powell’s Press Conference FINAL

checks.issue: As above; kept once, not once a page.
A guard, not a fix: a footer that names nothing but the page is not kept with the header.
